params.name: apikey
params.description: API key issued by the IEEE Developer Portal. Required on every request.

params.name: querytext
params.description: Free-text search across all configured metadata fields and abstract text. Use for general keyword searches.

params.name: abstract
params.description: Search text within the abstract field only.

params.name: affiliation
params.description: Search by author institutional affiliation text.

params.name: article_number
params.description: IEEE unique identifier for a specific article. Use to retrieve a single known document.

params.name: article_title
params.description: Search within the article title field.

params.name: author
params.description: Search by author name.

params.name: booleantext
params.description: Boolean query against all configured metadata fields, abstract, and document text. Supports AND, OR, NOT operators.

params.name: content_type
params.description: Filter results by content type.

params.name: d_au
params.description: Faceted author search using Open Author Facet data field.

params.name: d_pubtype
params.description: Faceted content-type filter using Open Content Type Facet data field.

params.name: d_year
params.description: Faceted publication year filter.

params.name: doi
params.description: Search or retrieve a document by its Digital Object Identifier.

params.name: end_date
params.description: Upper bound for publication date filter. Format: YYYYMMDD or YYYY.

params.name: index_terms
params.description: Search within author keywords, IEEE Terms, and MeSH Terms.

params.name: isbn
params.description: Search by International Standard Book Number.

params.name: issn
params.description: Search by International Standard Serial Number.

params.name: is_number
params.description: IEEE internal journal issue identifier.

params.name: max_records
params.description: Maximum number of records to return per request. Default is 25; maximum is 200.

params.name: publication_number
params.description: IEEE unique publication record number (journal or conference).

params.name: publication_title
params.description: Search within the publication title (journal, conference, or book name).

params.name: publication_year
params.description: Filter results by publication year.

params.name: sort_field
params.description: Field to sort results by.

params.name: sort_order
params.description: Sort direction.

params.name: start_date
params.description: Lower bound for publication date filter. Format: YYYYMMDD or YYYY.

params.name: start_record
params.description: Sequence number of the first record to return. Used for pagination. Default is 1.

params.name: format
params.description: Response format. Default is json.

items.docs: Query and retrieve metadata records and abstracts for more than 6 million documents in IEEE Xplore including journals, conference proceedings, standards, books, and courses. Supports free-text, Boolean, and fielded searches. Returns up to 200 records per request with JSON (default) or XML output. The apikey query parameter is required on every request.
